amendment.purpose: sought to prevent funds in the bill from being used to abolish law enforcement offices at the Bureau of Land Management and the U.S. Forest Service.

amendment.author: Lowenthal
amendment.purpose: At the end of the bill (before the short title), insert the following: SEC. __. None of the funds made available by this Act may be used in contravention of Secretarial Order 3289, issued by the Secretary of the Interior on September 14, 2009, and addressing the impacts of climate change on America's water, land, and other natural and cultural resources.

amendment.author: Pocan
amendment.purpose: sought to protect the Administration's climate change and environmental sustainability executive order to ensure that no funds be used to weaken the Executive Order 13693.

amendment.author: Polis
amendment.purpose: sought to prohibit the use of funds to pursue any additional legal ways to transfer Federal lands to private owners in contravention of existing law.

amendment.author: Tsongas
amendment.purpose: sought to prevent a provision of the bill that would block BLM resource management plans from going into effect if failing to implement the plans would limit BLM's ability to meet its multiple use obligations, including providing opportunities for hunting, fishing, and outdoor recreation.

amendment.author: Norcross
amendment.purpose: sought to redirect $15,282,000 within the Hazardous Substance Superfund account.

amendment.author: Gallego
amendment.purpose: sought to prohibit funds from being used to issue grazing permits or leases in contravention of BLM regulations.

amendment.author: Conyers
amendment.purpose: sought to exempt from the bill any settlement pertaining to discrimination based on race, religion, national origin, or any other protected category.

amendment.author: Cicilline
amendment.purpose: sought to exempt settlement agreements that strengthen the personal privacy of Americans from the blanket prohibition.

amendment.author: Jackson Lee
amendment.purpose: sought to exempt settlement agreements that resolve a civil action or potential civil action in relation to sexual harassment, violence, or discrimination in the work place.

amendment.author: Gosar
amendment.purpose: sought to cap settlement payments for attorney fees provided in relation to environmental cases at $125 per hour.

amendment.author: Boustany
amendment.purpose: requires the results of a Regulatory Impact Analysis (RIA) or a similar cost-benefit analysis, as well as the formula and data for the analysis to be included in the details disclosed by the agency on either regulations.gov or on the executive agency's website.

amendment.author: Walz
amendment.purpose: sought to remove all accountability provisions from the bill by striking sections 2 through 8 and section 10.

amendment.author: Takano
amendment.purpose: sought to replace section 3 with a new provision allowing the Secretary to suspend without pay any VA employee whose performance or misconduct threatens public health or safety, including the health and safety of veterans; and may remove a suspended employee after such investigation and review as the Secretary considers necessary.

amendment.author: Kuster
amendment.purpose: sought to expedite the removal or demotion of a member of the Senior Executive Service.

amendment.author: Takano
amendment.purpose: extends the Department of Veterans Affairs authority for the performance of medical disability evaluations by contract physicians by one year.

amendment.author: Takano
amendment.purpose: enables any person who is entitled to retired pay for nonregular (reserve) service or who, but for age, would be so entitled to be honored as a veteran. A person shall not be entitled to any benefit by reason of such recognition.

amendment.author: Takano
amendment.purpose: allows the Secretary of the VA to furnish rehabilitative equipment to Veterans entitled to prosthetic appliances, and modify non-rehabilitative equipment owned by the Veteran to meet that purpose.

amendment.author: Duffy
amendment.purpose: Senate amendment inserts a complete new text entitled "Eliminate, Neutralize, and Disrupt Wildlife Trafficking Act of 2016" and appears on page H5741 of the Congressional Record of September 21, 2016.

amendment.author: Cicilline
amendment.purpose: sought to exempt from the requirements of the legislation any rule that would reduce the cost of healthcare for people over the age of 65.

amendment.author: DelBene
amendment.purpose: sought to exempt from the bill's requirements rules relating to improving the affordability of higher education.

amendment.author: Engel
amendment.purpose: sought to require the President to notify Congress of a payment made to any state sponsor of terrorism or North Korea pursuant to a settlement or judgment against the United States.

amendment.author: Graves (LA)
amendment.purpose: sought to allow the non-federal interest to execute a project or project component when they determine that it can be done at lower cost and/or faster time. Also, the amendment directs 20% of the cost savings back to the United States Treasury for deficit reduction.

amendment.author: Joyce
amendment.purpose: amends the Clean Water Act to reauthorize the Great Lakes Restoration Initiative.

amendment.purpose: authorizes the Secretary to provide additional assistance under section 219 of the Water Resources Development Act of 1992 for certain communities for the repair or replacement of public and private infrastructure in any State for which the President has declared an emergency under the Stafford Act as a result of the presence of chemical, physical, or biological constituents, including lead or other contaminants in the eligible system.

amendment.author: Conyers
amendment.purpose: sought to exempt from the bill rules that are necessary to prevent an imminent threat to health or safety or other emergency.

amendment.purpose: sought to exempt any rule promulgated to prevent, respond to, or mitigate matters of national security.
